title: XRECORD typed callback retention bounds
head: de27a3391a624aba03ca71f3583c4b3a6e6396a9
scope: Bound adapter-owned typed XRECORD callback copies across the dx_data container lifetime
Account for table-entry dynamic fields, typed and ordered value variants, handles, raw bytes, and immutable DWG source snapshot storage
Make any incomplete or over-budget XRECORD capture fail closed before DXF output publication
Add generated fast tests for exact admission, over-budget rejection, sticky failure, copy independence, and destination preservation

controls: Typed and ordered variant strings and binary payloads are charged alongside vector elements
The additional dynamic payload retained by the immutable DWG source snapshot is conservatively charged per callback copy
Exact-fit aggregate record, item, and byte limits admit a generated XRECORD
Record, item, and byte over-budget attempts refuse copies and leave counters unchanged
Capture failure remains sticky and DXF export refuses before replacing an existing destination
implementation.limitations: Logical payload accounting is conservative and does not measure allocator capacity or RSS. This capture bound does not qualify XRECORD graph closure, serializer fidelity, DWG-origin output, or native consumer acceptance.

localEvidence: The adapter's previous addXRecord callback used an unbounded list push; the replacement funnels it through aggregate record/item/byte admission.
The DWG XRECORD parser may retain an immutable source snapshot containing a duplicate of its public dynamic payload; the adapter estimate charges that additional dynamic payload.
The generated regression control uses only in-memory C++ objects and a temporary destination sentinel; no persistent or downloaded drawing fixture was added.
